bugs.what: Barrow doors transitioned from 'locked' to open silently after blessing—no confirmation message that blessing worked

confusions: At first barrow visit, unclear how to proceed with locked doors—had to deduce blessing path by revisiting NPCs
'Speak the binding rite' option wasn't explicitly framed as 'speak the three verses together'
suggestions: Add explicit flavor text when blessing unlocks doors (e.g., 'The stone doors glow faintly and creak open')
Label the verse-speaking action as 'speak the three verses at the throne' for clarity
Tutorial hint about exploring and talking to NPCs to unlock resources would help blind players
Consider adding a compass or map after learning locations to reduce backtracking
